purpose: Two files of qa written before the catalogue of definitions. They are kept as they are and are not rules of the game; this map says which of their keys name a definition of the catalogue.
markerMeaning: NO_CATALOG_ID: no implemented definition of the catalogue answers to the key. OUT_OF_PLAN_FRAME: outside the frame of docs/NOWY_PLAN_GRY.md (sections 1-2); not mapped to K01-K14, not to be migrated, and any reuse of the content is BLOCKED_PLAN_CONFLICT.
fieldMeaning: catalogId: the implemented definition the key names, or a marker. candidateId (optional): a planned, not yet implemented definition the key may come to name; a guess recorded with its ground and confidence in note, not a mapping, because the numbers of these files are not rules of the game. An empty candidateId: the possible counterparts are named in note and none is chosen.
hashRule: sha256 of the bytes of the file with every CR LF read as LF, so the pin does not depend on how the file was checked out
